title: Playing serenades as a boy
summary: As a child Garland played bass in three-piece serenading groups with mandolin and guitar for fun.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: When you first started, did you play in little street bands, like little skiffle bands, and so on? I played with three pieces.
Yeah. Like when you were a kid,

children? Yeah, madeline, guitar and bass. Just serenading, going on a serenading, you know. Go around the house, having good times, you know, go in one of those houses, sit on there, there's a good boy named Chicken, and Arthur Banks, uh-uh, Arthur, yeah. We used to go there, his wife played guitar, he played madeline, and I'd have my bass, and I'd sit down, just play, you know.

Yeah, they'd sit down, play, you know. Then we'd go out to somebody else's house and play, you know. Just go around, just play, and we wouldn't get nothing, just go around playing, and we'd come there, you always sit down and play anything.
And would they give you food or a few dollars?
No. They'd give us nothing. Nothing. People would know. We'd always go in there, and they'd sit in there, drinking and having a good time. Just partying. Having a little party. Having fun.
Did you ever play any other instruments aside from bass?
Just play guitar. Oh, you play guitar. I like guitar.
You don't like it? I like it.
I always like a guitar, but I didn't like it myself. I'm crazy about guitar, playing while I'm guitar. I don't know why I wouldn't.
